info.description: Generated from worker/src/routes by scripts/export-openapi.ts; do not edit. Errors use the 03 §2.2 envelope with GLOSSARY §5 codes.

PublicConfigDto.description: Public remote config (03 §8.2). Keys are the GLOSSARY §8.1 names; store.packs[] carries the Worker-injected credits.

AttestChallenge.description: Stateless challenge (03 §3.2): base64url(nonce16 ‖ exp8 ‖ HMAC[0..16]), valid 5 minutes. powBits applies only to a `type: none` registration (§2.4).

installSecret.description: 32 random bytes, base64url; sent only on this route (RC54).
